```{r}
theme_Publication <- function(base_size=14, base_family="arial") {
      library(grid)
      library(ggthemes)
      (theme_foundation(base_size=base_size, base_family=base_family)
       + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                         size = rel(1.2), hjust = 0.5),
               text = element_text(),
               panel.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               plot.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               panel.border = element_rect(colour = NA),
               axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = rel(1)),
               axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90,vjust =2),
               axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
               axis.text = element_text(), 
               axis.line = element_line(colour="black"),
               axis.ticks = element_line(),
               panel.grid.major = element_line(colour="#f0f0f0"),
               panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
               legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA),
               legend.position = "bottom",
               legend.direction = "horizontal",
               legend.key.size= unit(0.2, "cm"),
               legend.margin = unit(0, "cm"),
               legend.title = element_text(face="italic"),
               plot.margin=unit(c(10,5,5,5),"mm"),
               strip.background=element_rect(colour="#f0f0f0",fill="#f0f0f0"),
               strip.text = element_text(face="bold")
          ))
      
}

scale_fill_Publication <- function(...){

}

scale_colour_Publication <- function(...){
      library(scales)
      discrete_scale("colour","Publication",manual_pal(values = c("#fdb462","#7fc97f","#ef3b2c","#662506","#a6cee3","#fb9a99","#984ea3","#ffff33")), ...)

}
```

```{r}
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)

# Get land
land <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Convert raster to data.frame
sst_df <- as.data.frame(sst_gbr, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
names(sst_df)[3] <- "sst"

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "grey70", color = NA) +
  geom_raster(data = sst_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = sst)) +
  scale_fill_viridis(name = "SST (°C)", option = "plasma", na.value = NA) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(140, 148), ylim = c(-20, -10), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "grey70", color = NA) +
  geom_raster(data = sst_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = sst), interpolate = TRUE) +  # smooth appearance
  scale_fill_viridis(name = "SST (°C)", option = "plasma") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(140, 148), ylim = c(-20, -10), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(rerddap)
library(sf)

# 1. Define date and bounding box
date      <- "2019-02-07"
lat_range <- c(-20, -10)
lon_range <- c(140, 148)

erddap_url <- "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/"

# 2. Get DHW and DHW max from NOAA_DHW dataset
dhw     <- griddap(datasetx = "NOAA_DHW",
                   url      = erddap_url,
                   time     = c(date, date),
                   latitude = lat_range,
                   longitude= lon_range,
                   fields   = "CRW_DHW",
                   fmt      = "nc")
```

```{r}
# 3. Load rasters
r_dhw     <- rast(dhw$summary$filename)

# Crop just to be safe
ext_gbr <- ext(lon_range[1], lon_range[2], lat_range[1], lat_range[2])
r_dhw     <- crop(r_dhw, ext_gbr)
r_dhw_flipped <- flip(r_dhw, direction = "vertical")
```

Plot all
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(rerddap)
library(lubridate)

# 1. Define bounding box and ERDDAP base URL
lat_range <- c(-20, -10)
lon_range <- c(140, 148)
erddap_url <- "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/"

# 2. Create a sequence of dates: every 7 days from Jan 1 to Apr 30 for years 2016-2020
dates <- seq.Date(from = as.Date("2016-01-01"),
                  to   = as.Date("2020-04-30"),
                  by   = "7 days") %>%
  # Keep only dates in Jan-Apr for each year
  keep(~ month(.) %in% 1:4)

# 3. Pre-download land polygons once
land <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# 4. Function to download and process a single date
get_dhw_max_df <- function(date, lat_range, lon_range, erddap_url) {
  date_chr <- as.character(date)
  message("Processing ", date_chr)
  
  # 4a. Use tryCatch to handle any errors (e.g., missing data)
  tryCatch({
    dhw_max <- griddap(datasetx = "NOAA_DHW",
                       url      = erddap_url,
                       time     = c(date_chr, date_chr),
                       latitude = lat_range,
                       longitude= lon_range,
                       fields   = "CRW_DHW",
                       fmt      = "nc")
    
    # 4b. Load raster
    r <- rast(dhw_max$summary$filename)
    
    # 4c. Crop and flip for orientation
    ext_gbr <- ext(lon_range[1], lon_range[2], lat_range[1], lat_range[2])
    r <- crop(r, ext_gbr)
    r <- flip(r, direction = "vertical")
    
    # 4d. Convert to dataframe, add date
    df <- as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
      rename(DHW_max = CRW_DHW) %>%
      mutate(date = date_chr)
    
    return(df)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Failed for ", date_chr, ": ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# 5. Loop over all dates, download and process data
all_dfs <- map(dates, get_dhw_max_df, lat_range = lat_range, lon_range = lon_range, erddap_url = erddap_url)

# 6. Bind all results together and filter out NULLs
all_dhw <- bind_rows(all_dfs)

# 7. Convert date to factor or Date for plotting facets
all_dhw <- all_dhw %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date))

# 8. Plot grid of maps using facets (e.g. facet_wrap by date)

DHW<- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "grey70", color = NA) +
  geom_raster(data = all_dhw, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = DHW_max)) +
  scale_fill_viridis(name = "DHW max (°C‑weeks)", option = "magma", na.value = "transparent") +
  coord_sf(xlim = lon_range, ylim = lat_range, expand = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ date, ncol = 20) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
DHW
```

Max DHW
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(rerddap)
library(lubridate)

httr::set_config(httr::config(connecttimeout = 120, timeout = 240))

# 1. Set spatial and temporal parameters
lat_range <- c(-20, -10)
lon_range <- c(140, 148)
erddap_url <- "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/"

# 2. Define weekly dates from Jan 1 2015 to Dec 31 2020
dates <- seq.Date(from = as.Date("2015-01-01"),
                  to   = as.Date("2020-12-31"),
                  by   = "7 days")

# 3. Download land only once
land <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# 4. Function to download and process a raster for a given date
get_dhw_raster <- function(date, lat_range, lon_range, erddap_url) {
  date_chr <- as.character(date)
  message("Processing ", date_chr)
  
  tryCatch({
    dhw <- griddap(datasetx = "NOAA_DHW",
                   url      = erddap_url,
                   time     = c(date_chr, date_chr),
                   latitude = lat_range,
                   longitude= lon_range,
                   fields   = "CRW_DHW",
                   fmt      = "nc")
    
    # Load and crop raster
    r <- rast(dhw$summary$filename)
    r <- crop(r, ext(lon_range[1], lon_range[2], lat_range[1], lat_range[2]))
    r <- flip(r, direction = "vertical")  # flip for correct orientation
    
    return(r)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Failed for ", date_chr, ": ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# 5. Loop over all dates and collect rasters
dhw_rasters <- map(dates, get_dhw_raster, lat_range = lat_range, lon_range = lon_range, erddap_url = erddap_url)

# 6. Filter out NULLs (failed downloads)
dhw_rasters <- compact(dhw_rasters)

# 7. Stack rasters and compute the per-pixel maximum
dhw_stack <- rast(dhw_rasters)
dhw_max_raster <- app(dhw_stack, fun = max, na.rm = TRUE)

# 8. Convert raster to data.frame for plotting
df_dhw_max <- as.data.frame(dhw_max_raster, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  rename(DHW_max = names(dhw_max_raster))

# 9. Plot the max DHW across all years
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "grey70", color = NA) +
  geom_raster(data = df_dhw_max, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = DHW_max)) +
  scale_fill_viridis(name = "Max DHW\n(°C-weeks)", option = "plasma", na.value = "transparent") +
  coord_sf(xlim = lon_range, ylim = lat_range, expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1)

unlink("dhw_nc", recursive = TRUE)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(rerddap)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
erddap_url <- "https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/"
```

```{r}
# Create a sequence of dates: every 7 days from Jan 1 to Apr 30 for years 2016-2020
dates <- seq.Date(from = as.Date("2016-01-01"),
                  to   = as.Date("2019-12-30"),
                  by   = "7 days") %>%
  # Keep only dates in Jan-Apr for each year
  keep(~ month(.) %in% 1:12)
```

```{r}
# Function to download and process a single date
get_sst_df <- function(date, lat_range, lon_range, erddap_url) {
  date_chr <- as.character(date)
  message("Processing ", date_chr)
  
  # 4a. Use tryCatch to handle any errors (e.g., missing data)
  tryCatch({
    sst <- griddap(datasetx = "NOAA_DHW",
                       url      = erddap_url,
                       time     = c(date_chr, date_chr),
                       latitude = lat_range,
                       longitude= lon_range,
                       fields   = "CRW_SST",
                       fmt      = "nc")
    
    # 4b. Load raster
    r <- rast(sst$summary$filename)
    
    # 4c. Crop and flip for orientation
    ext_gbr <- ext(lon_range[1], lon_range[2], lat_range[1], lat_range[2])
    r <- crop(r, ext_gbr)
    r <- flip(r, direction = "vertical")
    
    # 4d. Convert to dataframe, add date
    df <- as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
      rename(SST = CRW_SST) %>%
      mutate(date = date_chr)
    
    return(df)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Failed for ", date_chr, ": ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
}
```

```{r}
  dplyr::mutate(Reef = "Parke")

rm(par_sst)
```

Combine datasets
```{r}
sst<- rbind(dav_sst2, pal_sst2, swi_sst2, jew_sst2,  par_sst2)
#save(sst, file = "/Users/alexmacadam/Documents/GitHub/AGF-DArT/data/sst.rda")
load("/Users/alexmacadam/Documents/GitHub/AGF-DArT/data/sst.rda")
```

```{r}
north<- rbind(swi_sst2, jew_sst2,  par_sst2)
north2<- north |>
  dplyr::group_by(date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(SST) |>
  mutate(Region = "North")

central<- rbind(dav_sst2, pal_sst2)
central2<- central |>
  dplyr::group_by(date) |>
  dplyr::summarise(SST) |>
  mutate(Region = "Central")

sst2<- rbind(central2, north2)
```

Plot SST
```{r}
sst_line<- sst2 |> 
ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x = date, y = SST, colour = Region)) +
  theme_Publication() +
  labs(x="Date", y="SST (°C)") +
  theme(plot.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank()
        ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0161b2", "#f74652"))
```

```{r}
sst_dens<- sst2 |>
ggplot() +
  geom_density(aes(x = SST, fill = Region), alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_Publication() +
  labs(y="Density", x="SST (°C)") +
  theme(plot.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank()
        ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0161b2", "#f74652"))
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)
sst_plots<- sst_line / sst_dens + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") + plot_layout(nrow = 2, guides = "collect", widths = c(1,1))
```
